item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Tejas placing a thick wooden board between a lamp and a white screen. Light from the lamp is blocked by the board before it reaches the screen.

Which claim about the shadow is correct?

options.A: A dark shadow forms on the screen because the wooden board blocks light from the lamp.
options.B: A dark shadow forms on the lamp side of the wooden board, not on the screen.
options.C: No shadow forms on the screen while the lamp is on, because the wooden board is thick.
options.D: A dark shadow stays on the screen after the lamp is switched off.
